prompt_summary: Original cozy 32-pixel-style transit sheet inspired by Toucheng coastal architecture, a Ruifang hill station, a Jiufen tea house, a vintage railcar and bus, and a red lantern. Isolated on transparent background.
integration: Godot work/generate_transit_atlas.gd uses manually selected 3×2 source bounds, removes weak alpha outside the prop, trims the visible silhouette, downsamples nearest, and packs 128×96 fixed cells. Building floor widths and baselines use core collision footprints; railway details reuse the existing cavern track.
scope: Fictional compressed environments inspired by the named places.
